summary: One major defect found: Problem 4's answer field silently corrects a source error (lists/describes) instead of preserving it verbatim. The candidate's own note acknowledges the source text but the answer value contradicts this. One additional suspicious formula in Problem 2 solution could not be definitively verified from the low-resolution scan but appears inconsistent with standard physics notation.

defects.description: The answer field contains 'Описват се блясък, цвят и ъглово отстояние...' (describe), but the candidate's own answer.note field explicitly states the source prints 'се списват' (lists), not 'се описват' (describes). A source error should be preserved verbatim in the answer.value field with the error noted separately, not silently corrected in the main field.
defects.suggestedFix: ...разглеждат се визуално и се списват - блясък, цвят, ъглово отстояние... (restore original text; preserve the source error verbatim)

defects.description: The solution contains the formula '$V_r = c\,\Delta\lambda/\lambda_0^2$' with squared lambda_0 in denominator. Standard Doppler shift formula uses first power: $V_r = c\,\Delta\lambda/\lambda_0$. Later in same formula block, candidate has '$V_\theta = c\,\Delta_\lambda/\lambda_0$' (correct form). This inconsistency suggests either a misreading or source error. Candidate's note acknowledges formulas are partially illegible in source.
defects.suggestedFix: Verify formula against original PDF; likely should be '$V_r = c\,\Delta\lambda/\lambda_0$' (remove ^2 from denominator)
